remarks: This timeless brick Georgian Colonial is sited on a stunning 2+ acre parcel on a coveted private drive in Mid Country Greenwich, South of the Parkway and minutes to downtown. The scene is set upon your initial approach, with mature trees and expansive Belgian block-lined horseshoe drive. The gently rolling grounds offer a walk-out lower level, tiered patios and terraces with beautiful masonry detail, and park-like backyard offering endless possibilities. The interior is a vision from the past, awaiting a discerning buyer or builder's inspiration. An elegant entry Foyer gives way to a formal dining room, expansive formal living room and private office/study - both with wood-burning fireplaces. The eat-in kitchen offers solid wood cabinetry, center island, casual dining area, and views of the pristine rear landscape and outdoor entertaining areas. The sunken Great Room offers soaring vaulted ceilings, a third wood-burning fireplace, and access to an al fresco dining terrace and sunken hardscape outdoor lounge area. Deceivingly large, the main level also offers an additional living wing, with private entry from the garage and rear yard - This space includes a bedroom suite with full bath, as well as a large bonus room with kitchenette. Upstairs, find four total bedrooms and three full baths: An elegant primary suite offers two walk-in closets, primary bath with tub, shower, and double vanity, and access to an oversized roofdeck above the two-car garage; (CONTINUED)
